name: comp-595
title: Collab Nav Header
description: A slim dark header for a shared document, holding a back chevron, the title Basic UI, three round icon actions for history, comments and adding people, and an avatar stack with presence dots.
use: A collaborative editor needs presence avatars and quick comment or history actions in one bar.
avoid: The avatar photos are hardcoded files, and the action buttons do nothing beyond a hover tint.
a11y: Buttons and avatars carry names, but the avatar group is not announced as a unit and the actions are inert. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A slim dark header with a back chevron, the title Basic UI, three round ghost icons (clock, comment, add person), then an avatar stack of three small photos with presence dots and a +3 circle.
behaves: Hovering any icon, avatar or the +3 circle lightens its background; nothing else opens in the clip. The small dots under the photos mark which collaborators are online.
customise: Title, three avatar images, names and the +3 count are hardcoded; the icon buttons have no handlers, so actions need wiring.
weight: light: A title, four small buttons and three small avatars.
demo: The title reads Basic UI; avatars stand for Kelly King, Martha Johnson and Linda Green, with +3 more.
issues: The comment icon button is labelled Save, so assistive tech announces the wrong action.
polishWhy: Tidy collaboration bar with clear presence dots; the action buttons are only decorative here.
